title: Assistive Partner Views Interest Expressed (Summary View) and Notifications - Functional Test Plan
overview: Comprehensive functional testing of the Interest Expressed feature on the Y4J AT/AD Vendor Portal. Covers access and navigation to the Interest Expressed tab, summary metrics and notification indicators, interest list view with pagination and sorting, search/filter/sort functionality, View Details modal with PwD information, Reveal Contact Details with privacy controls, product interest details, data accuracy and permissions, download/export functionality, notification of new interest, notification center management, data refresh, privacy compliance, error handling, and audit tracking.

inScope: Interest Expressed tab access and navigation from vendor dashboard
Summary metrics: Total Interest count widget
Interest list view: columns (Name, Age, Disability Type, Location, Product, Shares, Date, Action)
Default sorting (Newest First) and sort order toggle
View Details modal: personal info, date/time, masked contact, location, products
Modal close behavior (X icon, click outside)
Reveal Contact Details: unmask phone/email with audit logging
Product interest details: name, thumbnail, share count
Data accuracy: vendor can only see interests for own products
Read-only access: no edit/delete of interest records
Download List: export with filters/sorting respected
Notification Center: view, mark read, delete notifications
Error handling: empty state, data retrieval failure messages
Privacy compliance: data minimization, masked contacts by default

linkedIssues.summary: State filter not working in Interest Expressed tab
Disability Type filter not working in Interest Expressed tab

testCases.title: Verify Interest Expressed tab is visible and accessible from vendor dashboard
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as an approved Assistive Partner with at least one listed product
steps: 1. Log in as an approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to the vendor dashboard
3. Verify the 'Interest Expressed' tab is visible in the dashboard navigation
4. Click on the 'Interest Expressed' tab
5. Verify the page loads without errors
6. Verify a clear heading is displayed explaining the section purpose
7. Verify a description text is shown explaining what the section contains
expectedResults: Interest Expressed tab is visible in dashboard navigation
Tab is clickable and navigates to the interest summary page
Page loads without console errors or broken UI
Clear heading and descriptive text are displayed
testCases.postconditions: User is on the Interest Expressed page

testCases.title: Verify Interest Expressed tab is not visible for unapproved vendors
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as a vendor whose account is pending approval
steps: 1. Log in as a vendor with pending approval status
2. Navigate to the vendor dashboard
3. Check if the 'Interest Expressed' tab is visible in navigation
expectedResults: Interest Expressed tab is NOT visible for unapproved vendors
No access to interest data without approved status
testCases.postconditions: User remains on dashboard without access to Interest Expressed

testCases.title: Verify Total Interest metric widget displays correct cumulative count
testCases.preconditions: Approved AP with products that have received interest from PwD users
steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab
3. Verify the 'Total Interest' metric widget is displayed
4. Verify the count matches the total number of interest records
5. Verify the widget is prominently placed on the page
expectedResults: Total Interest widget is visible on the page
Count accurately reflects cumulative interest submissions
Widget is clearly labeled and easy to read
testCases.postconditions: Dashboard metrics are displayed correctly

testCases.title: Verify notification indicator appears when new interest is recorded
testCases.preconditions: Approved AP is logged in; a new PwD interest is recorded for their product
steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner
2. Verify initial notification state (no new notifications)
3. Have a PwD user express interest in one of the AP's products
4. Verify a notification indicator appears on the dashboard
5. Verify the notification links to the Interest Expressed section
6. Click the notification indicator
7. Verify navigation to Interest Expressed section
expectedResults: Notification indicator appears when new interest is recorded
Indicator is visually distinct (badge/dot/count)
Clicking notification navigates to Interest Expressed section
Total Interest count increments accordingly
testCases.postconditions: User is on Interest Expressed page with updated data

testCases.title: Verify interest list displays all required columns with correct data

steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab
3. Verify the list displays the following columns:
a. Name & basic profile details (age, disability type)
b. Location (city, state)
c. Interested product(s)
d. Number of shares
e. Interest date
f. Action (View Details button)
4. Verify data in each column matches actual PwD submissions
5. Verify all columns are properly aligned and readable
expectedResults: All six columns are displayed in the list
Data is accurate and matches PwD interest submissions
Columns are properly labeled and aligned
View Details action button is present for each row
testCases.postconditions: Interest list is displayed with complete data

testCases.title: Verify pagination with result count display

steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner

4. Verify result count text shows (e.g., 'Showing 1-10 of X results')
5. Click 'Next' page button
6. Verify next set of results loads
7. Verify result count updates (e.g., 'Showing 11-20 of X results')
8. Click 'Previous' page button
9. Verify navigation back to first page
expectedResults: Pagination controls are visible when results exceed page size
Result count text accurately shows current range and total
Next/Previous navigation works correctly
Page transitions are smooth without full page reload

testCases.title: Verify default sorting is Newest First

steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab
3. Verify the list is sorted by interest date in descending order (newest first)
4. Verify the first record has the most recent date
5. Verify subsequent records have progressively older dates
expectedResults: Default sort order is Newest First (descending by date)
Most recent interest appears at the top
Sort indicator shows descending/newest first as active

2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab

5. Verify the list updates to show only matching results
6. Verify results contain the searched name
7. Clear the search field
8. Verify all results are displayed again
expectedResults: Search field is visible and functional
Entering a name filters the list to matching records
Results update without full page reload
Clearing search restores the full list

testCases.title: Verify sort order can be changed between newest and oldest first
testCases.preconditions: Approved AP with multiple interest records with different dates

7. Verify the list reorders with newest records at the top

testCases.title: Verify View Details modal opens without navigating away from page
testCases.preconditions: Approved AP on Interest Expressed page with at least one record
steps: 1. Log in as approved Assistive Partner
2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab
3. Click 'View Details' action button on any interest record
4. Verify a modal/popup opens
5. Verify the page URL does not change (no navigation)

a. Personal information summary (age, disability type)
b. Date and time when interest was expressed
c. Masked contact information
d. Location and full address
e. List of products the PwD has shown interest in
expectedResults: Modal opens as an overlay without page navigation
All required information fields are displayed
Contact information is masked by default
Product list shows all products the PwD expressed interest in
testCases.postconditions: Modal is open with PwD details displayed

testCases.title: Verify modal can be closed using X icon

steps: 1. With the View Details modal open
2. Locate the Close (X) icon on the modal
3. Click the X icon
4. Verify the modal closes
5. Verify the interest list is still visible and unchanged
expectedResults: X icon is visible and clickable
Clicking X closes the modal
Underlying page content is preserved
No data loss or page reload occurs
testCases.postconditions: Modal is closed, user is back on interest list

testCases.title: Verify contact details are masked by default in modal
testCases.preconditions: View Details modal is open for a PwD record
steps: 1. Open View Details modal for any interest record
2. Verify phone number is masked (e.g., '****1234' or similar pattern)
3. Verify email is masked (e.g., 'a***@***.com' or similar pattern)
4. Verify a 'Reveal Details' button is visible
expectedResults: Phone number is masked and not readable
Email address is masked and not readable
Reveal Details button is clearly visible and labeled
testCases.postconditions: Contact details remain masked until explicitly revealed

testCases.title: Verify Reveal Details unmasks phone and email with audit logging
testCases.preconditions: View Details modal is open with masked contact details
steps: 1. Open View Details modal for a PwD record
2. Verify contact details are masked
3. Click 'Reveal Details' button
4. Verify phone number is now fully visible
5. Verify email address is now fully visible
6. Verify the reveal action is logged for audit purposes
expectedResults: Clicking Reveal Details shows full phone number
Clicking Reveal Details shows full email address

Revealed details are accurate and match PwD submission
testCases.postconditions: Contact details are visible; action is audit-logged

testCases.title: Verify vendor can only reveal details for PwDs interested in their products
testCases.preconditions: Multiple APs exist; PwD has expressed interest in products from different APs
steps: 1. Log in as Assistive Partner A
2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab

4. Verify Reveal Details is available only for these records
5. Verify no records from other APs' products are visible

Reveal Details is restricted to own product interests only

b. Product image thumbnail
c. Number of times the product was shared
3. Verify only products owned by the logged-in AP are shown

testCases.preconditions: Approved AP on Interest Expressed page

3. Verify no edit buttons/icons are present on interest records
4. Verify no delete buttons/icons are present on interest records
5. Verify right-click context menu does not offer edit/delete options
6. Verify the View Details modal has no edit/delete functionality
expectedResults: No edit functionality is available for interest records
No delete functionality is available for interest records

testCases.postconditions: Data integrity is protected from vendor modification

testCases.title: Verify vendors cannot view interests for products they do not own
testCases.preconditions: Multiple APs exist with different products; PwDs have expressed interest in various products

2. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab

5. Navigate to Interest Expressed tab
6. Verify only interests for AP B's products are displayed
7. Verify no overlap between AP A and AP B interest records
expectedResults: Each AP sees only interests for their own products
No cross-vendor data is accessible
Data isolation is enforced at the application level
testCases.postconditions: Vendor data isolation is confirmed
